conversation.subject: Lumen panel cards revert to amber after Done - LMN-47
conversation.body: Confirmed: choosing Done now keeps the Lumen cards green after reopening, and banner LMN-47 no longer appears.

private_notes.body: Human investigation reproduced LMN-47 in the Lumen review panel on release 2.4 and confirmed an application defect, not an incomplete review or a guidance request. Lumen is an internal name for a custom Salesforce review component; its Done action writes review-state records directly in Salesforce. No Boomi process, NetSuite update or Sitecore page participates in this action. Salesforce Support confirmed ownership of this component and diagnostic code, and the ticket was classified Application Support and assigned to Salesforce / GRP-SALESFORCE. The Salesforce administrator repaired the review-state permission configuration and verified persistence after reopening; the requester confirmed the fix. The service owner recorded that a recurrence on Lumen release 2.4 with LMN-47 and the same green-to-amber transition belongs to the Salesforce support queue for investigation. This establishes support ownership, not the root cause of a future incident.
